question: Which product shape should OpenClaw support for stale Discord thread session cleanup: preview-first prune, agent/operator delete, automatic TTL cleanup, or no automatic cleanup for now?
rationale: All viable fixes can delete persisted session state or hide conversation history, so automation should not choose the permission model, false-positive policy, or retention behavior without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve preview-first prune
options.body: Add plugin-owned Discord reachability and revalidation behind a preview/apply cleanup flow before exposing automatic or agent-initiated deletion.

options.title: Expose controlled delete
options.body: Add an explicit admin-scoped agent/operator deletion path for selected stale sessions while leaving automatic orphan discovery for a later design.

options.title: Defer destructive cleanup
options.body: Keep the current reset-only behavior and rely on manual selected-session deletion until false-positive and retention policy are settled.

recommendation.title: Approve preview-first prune
recommendation.body: Add plugin-owned Discord reachability and revalidation behind a preview/apply cleanup flow before exposing automatic or agent-initiated deletion.

likelyOwner.reason: Session maintenance and durable-conversation preservation history makes this the strongest product-policy owner for destructive cleanup behavior.
